newsitem.title: USA: Pittston Brink's sees Q1 shr passing $0.35.
newsitem.headline: Pittston Brink's sees Q1 shr passing $0.35.

text.p: Pittston Brink's Group said Thursday its earnings for the first quarter will likely exceed the estimate of $0.35 per share held among industry analysts.

The company, which was citing the First Call consensus among analysts, said it was enjoying "strong demand" in North America for its security services, especially for the automatic teller machine servicing market.
Overseas affiliates were also reporting "strong" operating profits, it said.
The company, which is to release its results on April 24, said it expected net earnings to improve further as debt and related interest expenses diminish.
The group reported a profit of $0.31 a share for the same period last year.
Pittston Brink's Group is the class of common stock of Pittston Co that reflects the performance of Brink's Inc and Brink's Home Security Inc.
Pittston Co is diversified company with interests in security services, global freight transportation and coal mining, among other things.
